maya: Quick one — v3-int4 shadow run (24h) finished. Overall throughput + good, tail latency ~+8%, but two safety slices show fidelity drops. Proposing conservative staged promotion ladder + an escape hatch. Summary below.

maya: ```
service: conv-gen
shadow_traffic: 5%
primary_metric: concordance (RWD)
baseline v2p3: 92.1%
v3-int4 shadow: 86.3% (delta -5.8)
hallucination-rate (auto-eval): 0.7% -> 1.9% (+1.2)
latency_p95: 220ms -> 238ms (+8%)
```

jon: @maya can you paste slice names + counts? want to check stat sig and sample stability.

maya: Slice long-doc-summ (n=1,200) concordance -12.1 (p~0.02)
Slice instr-follow (n=8,000) concordance -3.0 (p~0.12)
Overall smoke p=0.001

sam: :thinking_face: -12 on long-doc is worrying. do we have example failures or a pattern (code blocks, citations, numbers)?

maya: examples: short factual insertions in code snippets, minor attribution drift in 3/30 long-doc failures. attaching 3 quick failcases in the folder.

eva: Recommendation: keep shadow only, block promotion above 1% traffic. Add auto-fallback triggers: if concordance delta >5% absolute on any safety slice OR hallucination increase >0.5% absolute, rollback instantly. Agree? :warning:

jon: Agree with conservative thresholds. Also suggest enabling kv-warmup for long-doc slices and prefix caching in the bridge during canary to reduce tail.

sam: @jon can we run a targeted A/B (0.5% long-doc, 0.5% instr) for 12h and compute bootstrap CIs + p-values? low traffic but focused slices should surface noise.

maya: I'll schedule that split: 0.5% long-doc, 0.5% instr-follow, rest shadow. Deploy window 12:00-18:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll add an eval that flags hallucination examples with exact-match failure for quick triage.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: v3-int4-shadow -> cohorts [long-doc:0.5%, instr-follow:0.5%] at 2025-06-15T12:00:00Z. Ping @sam @jon @maya if blocking.

eva: :thumbsup: also set auto-unpromote cooldown 30m and require 3 consecutive buckets to pass before increasing traffic by 2x.

jon: I'll add observability panel (concordance, hallucination-rate, latency_p95, per-slice counts, p-values, sample sizes). ETA ~3h.

maya: Thanks. Final escape-hatch rule in doc: if any safety slice delta >= 7% OR hallucination >1.0% absolute, trigger immediate rollback to v2p3 and notify on-call. We'll keep shadow until targeted A/B completes and noise is understood.

sam: sounds good. i'll validate failcases and help build the tiny eval set for long-docs.

eva: I'll update the rollout playbook with the exact thresholds and cooldowns.

maya: ok locking this plan, will post short follow-up with links to artifacts and the three failcases. :eyes:
